rules.description: Process command line contains a credential-like value.
rules.exploit: Read the process command line and reuse the exposed credential or token to authenticate to the associated service.

rules.description: Root process is executing a program from a temporary or shared-memory location.
rules.exploit: Replace the referenced executable with attacker-controlled code when the file is writable, then wait for or trigger execution by the root process.

rules.description: Root process executes a program from a non-standard application location.
rules.exploit: Inspect the referenced executable and its dependencies for unprivileged write access, then replace a writable execution component to obtain root execution.

rules.description: Root Node.js process is running with the inspector enabled.
rules.exploit: Connect to an accessible Node.js inspector endpoint and use the debugging interface to execute JavaScript in the context of the Node.js process.

rules.description: Root process is running an interactive or script-capable interpreter.
rules.exploit: Inspect the root interpreter process for attacker-controlled scripts, writable imports, environment-controlled modules, or other execution paths that can be modified by the current user.
